decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly putting out aggressive creatures and leveraging Winota, Joiner of Forces to rapidly generate additional threats on the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, powerful board presence while utilizing cards like Edgewall Innkeeper and Elite Spellbinder to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using Winota's triggered ability to put additional creatures into play, the deck can quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for added flexibility and consistency in mana production.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up quickly and put pressure on the opponent with powerful creatures and efficient removal spells. By using Jegantha as a companion, the deck gains access to extra mana while maintaining a focused aggro strategy. Lovestruck Beast and Jaspera Sentinel provide early board presence, while cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Esika's Chariot help to refill your hand and generate additional threats. The mana base is optimized for consistent color access, allowing the deck to curve out smoothly and maintain pressure on the opponent.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and removal, using counterspells and removal spells like Heartless Act and Power Word Kill to control the board. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Ashiok, Nightmare Muse and Shark Typhoon to generate value and create threats. The inclusion of cards like Midnight Clock and Mazemind Tome allows the player to draw more cards and outvalue their opponent. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant position and close out the game with powerful finishers like Iymrith, Desert Doom.

This deck focuses on utilizing Winota, Joiner of Forces to cheat creatures with powerful enters-the-battlefield abilities into play, creating explosive combat situations and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive attacks. Cards like Elite Spellbinder and Lotus Cobra provide additional value while Winota's ability triggers. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply constant pressure on the opponent, utilizing powerful creatures like Blade Historian and Kenrith, the Returned King to close out games. Land cards like Lair of the Hydra and Fabled Passage offer mana fixing and additional utility to support the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with the goal of quickly overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and utilizing Winota, Joiner of Forces to generate additional value and board presence. The combination of creatures with triggered abilities like Elite Spellbinder and Selfless Savior, alongside strong supporting cards like Esika's Chariot and Kenrith, the Returned King, create a fast-paced and potent strategy that aims to outpace the opponent and secure a win through a combination of creature combat and synergy.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures to outvalue and outlast opponents. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with Cultivate and Emergent Ultimatum to cast big threats like Elder Gargaroth and Vorinclex. With Yorion as a companion, the deck can take advantage of blinking creatures and permanents for additional value. The deck also includes various board wipes and disruption spells to maintain board control and disrupt opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and card advantage to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By using efficient creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Elite Spellbinder, along with removal spells like Fire Prophecy and Giant Killer, the deck aims to control the board while attacking aggressively. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility. Showdown of the Skalds helps to refill the hand and continue the aggressive strategy. With a strong mana base and a mix of creatures and spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game.

This deck is focused on aggressive gameplay and utilizing the card Winota, Joiner of Forces as its main strategy. The deck includes creatures like Blade Historian, Elite Spellbinder, and Jaspera Sentinel to generate a strong board presence. The deck also features cards like Minsc, Beloved Ranger and Lotus Cobra for additional value and ramp potential. To support the deck's gameplan, it includes cards like Esika's Chariot and Ranger Class for additional creature generation and card advantage. The mana base is optimized with various pathways, Fabled Passage, and Lair of the Hydra to ensure consistent mana sources.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. With cards like Anax, Torbran, and Embercleave, it aims to create a strong board presence and push through damage efficiently. The inclusion of snow lands and Faceless Haven adds versatility and resilience to the deck, allowing it to have a consistent mana base while also providing a threat that can't be easily dealt with. Overall, the deck is built to be fast and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The deck focuses on using mill cards like Ruin Crab and Merfolk Windrobber to fill the opponent's graveyard, while utilizing control cards such as Drown in the Loch and Heartless Act to disrupt their strategy. Thieves' Guild Enforcer and Soaring Thought-Thief work well to capitalize on the opponent's graveyard being filled, allowing for quick damage and potential win conditions. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recurring creatures and spells, providing a consistent advantage over the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through attrition and graveyard manipulation.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of mill and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Ruin Crab and Merfolk Windrobber to mill the opponent's deck, as well as cards like Drown in the Loch and Heartless Act to remove threats, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ultimately win through card advantage and deck depletion. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional consistency and recursion to the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures. It utilizes cards like Polukranos, Unchained and Elder Gargaroth to apply pressure while also having access to Emergent Ultimatum for versatile win conditions. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents like Omen of the Sea and Binding the Old Gods. The deck has a strong mana base with a variety of pathways and triomes to ensure consistency in casting its spells.

This Sultai Control deck focuses on mana ramping early game with spells like Cultivate and Wolfwillow Haven, while utilizing powerful control cards such as Professor Onyx, Elder Gargaroth, and Binding the Old Gods to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Alrund's Epiphany and Kiora Bests the Sea God to close out the game. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility with the deck's permanent-heavy strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures and combat tricks to quickly reduce their life total to zero. By combining a mix of efficient creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant with powerful finishers like Embercleave and Goldspan Dragon, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the early game and maintain that pressure throughout the match. With a focus on board presence and rushdown tactics, this Gruul Aggro deck aims to outpace and outmuscle the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient, aggressive creatures like Gemrazer, Kazandu Mammoth, and Lovestruck Beast. It also utilizes powerful combat tricks like Blizzard Brawl and Primal Might to clear the way for your creatures to deal damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of efficient beaters and combat tricks while utilizing Ranger Class to generate additional value and provide card advantage. Faceless Haven provides a resilient threat that can close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on using low-cost creatures like Merfolk Windrobber and Thieves' Guild Enforcer to control the board and mill the opponent with Ruin Crab. It also utilizes counterspells like Disdainful Stroke and removal spells like Heartless Act to maintain control. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through card advantage with Into the Story and control the board through milling and removal, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and card advantage.
